name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC
description: Financial assistance to SC/ST/OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
eligibility: Must be Indian national belonging to SC/ST/OBC category, family annual income below ₹2.5 Lakh, studying in recognized institution.
benefits: Complete maintenance allowance, fee reimbursement up to 100%, study tour charges, thesis typing charges.
documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority, Previous Year Marksheet, Bank Account linked with Aadhaar, Fee Receipt.
process: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) online at scholarships.gov.in. Verification is done by Institute, District, and State Authorities.

name: Income Certificate Issuance & Verification Guidelines
description: Official proof of annual income issued by Revenue Department / Tehsildar office required for quota reservations, fee exemptions, and government welfare schemes.
eligibility: Any resident family claiming eligible income bracket for government benefits.
benefits: Valid proof of family income for 1 financial year across educational institutes, competitive exams, and government job applications.
documents: Salary Certificate / Form 16 / Income Affidavit, Bank Passbook (6 months), Aadhaar Card, Residence Proof (Ration Card/Electricity Bill), Self-declaration form.
process: Apply at e-District Portal of respective State or visit Meeseva / CSC center. Field inquiry by Revenue Inspector within 7–15 working days.

name: Aadhaar Card Name, Address & DOB Correction Process
description: Correction and update of demographic data (Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Address) and biometrics in UIDAI central database.
benefits: Ensures document consistency across PAN, Passport, Ration Card, Bank Account, and Marksheets.
documents: Name change: Gazette notification / Marriage Certificate / PAN card. Address: Bank Passbook, Electricity Bill, Voter ID. DOB: Birth Certificate, SSLC Marksheet.
process: Online demographic updates on myAadhaar portal (myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in) or visit Aadhaar Seva Kendra for biometric validation.

name: Right to Information (RTI) Filing Procedure
description: Empowers Indian citizens to request information from any public authority, government department, or public sector undertaking.
benefits: Mandatory response from Public Information Officer (PIO) within 30 days. First and Second Appeal mechanisms against non-response.
documents: Simple written application specifying questions clearly, proof of fee payment (₹10 postal order/online pay), BPL card if claiming fee exemption.
process: Submit application online at rtionline.gov.in or send physical application with court fee stamp/demand draft to PIO of public department.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land recorded in land records.
benefits: ₹6,000 annually paid in three installments of ₹2,000 directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
documents: Land record details (Khata/Khatian), Aadhaar Card, Aadhaar-linked Bank Account details, Active Mobile number.
process: Self-registration on Farmers Corner on pmkisan.gov.in or via CSC. Complete mandatory face/OTP e-KYC.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare scheme providing secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage.
eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 database under occupational or deprivation criteria.
benefits: Cashless and paperless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year in empaneled hospitals.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, PM-JAY Family ID / Ayushman Card.
process: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any empaneled hospital.
